headline: Millenium Associates adopts Ittikar private capital platform
summary: Millenium Associates AG joined Ittikar's private capital network designed for family offices, and Chairman Ray Soudah joined Ittikar's strategic advisory board.
why: Adoption of specialized fintech and private capital platforms expands alternative asset distribution networks for high-net-worth family offices.

impacts.name: Millenium Associates AG
impacts.why: Adopts private capital platform and joins Ittikar network.
